name: `shoptet refresh` + `shoptet update` / autoupdate
description:
shoptet refresh: atomically refreshes project-pinned platform knowledge (npm-published packs only in the MVP) as one versioned bundle, never N independent fetches. Supports --check (dry-run), --frozen (CI: resolve nothing, use the lockfile digest exactly, fail if unavailable), --json. Writes the lockfile. Implements the CLI-bundle compatibility contract from §9 (bundleVersion/schemaVersion/minCliVersion/generation/template/digest). Never triggered automatically by any other command.

shoptet update + shoptet config autoupdate on|off|status: upgrades the CLI itself via the package manager it was installed with. Automatic, once a day, on by default; skipped in CI, project-local installs, and for major versions (reminder only). SHOPTET_NO_AUTOUPDATE=1 env override. Copied from the Shopify CLI 4.0 shape.

Reference: cli-greenfield.md §9.
